summary: The PR fixes the issue with `DataArray.quantile` not honoring `keep_attrs`, but introduces some minor style and readability issues.

issues.description: The addition of `keep_attrs` parameter in `Variable.quantile` method could be improved by adding a default value and updating the docstring to clearly indicate the behavior.
The code could be slightly more readable by adding comments explaining the logic for handling `keep_attrs` in the `quantile` method.
